key_patterns: Crate graph (design §4): core (no internal deps) <- proto <- net; core <- platform <- platform-macos/-windows (cfg-gated, compile as empty libs elsewhere); agent (lib macwin_agent + bin macwin) depends on all. Core is pure: no I/O, threads or clocks; time passed in as Instant; Engine returns Vec<Action>. prost: never add #[derive(Debug)] to Message/Oneof types. Wire = protobuf ControlFrame/InputFrame/DatagramFrame with oneof (plan B2); golden InputFrame{Key{hid:0x070004,down:true}} = 22 06 08 84 80 1c 10 01. rustls: ring provider passed explicitly via builder_with_provider, TLS1.3 only, ALPN macwin/1, custom ServerCertVerifier + ClientCertVerifier pinning the SHA-256 of the end-entity cert. Transport-agnostic Link (mpsc channels, Inbound enum) between net and the driver; Link::memory_pair for in-process tests. Driver keeps Engine+injector+capture control in Arc<std::sync::Mutex<Core>>, never awaits while locked, lock order Core -> backend internals. Thiserror in libraries, anyhow in agent/keymap-gen, tracing for logs, clap derive for CLI.
